title: ₹2,507 Crore and Not a Single Hindi Release Since 2019: The Priyanka Chopra Empire Explained
excerpt: Fortune India and Interbrand just crowned her the third most valuable celebrity in India — the only woman in the top three — while she hasn't stepped on a Bollywood set in seven years.
body:
Here is a number that should make every actress in Mumbai's Film City stop and reconsider her strategy: ₹2,507 crore.

That's Priyanka Chopra Jonas's official brand value, as calculated by Fortune India and global brand consultancy Interbrand in their inaugural Most Valuable Celebrities 2026 ranking, published in Fortune India's June issue. It makes her the third most valuable celebrity in India — behind only Virat Kohli (₹3,542 crore) and Shah Rukh Khan (₹3,017 crore) — and the only woman in the top three.

https://youtube.com/watch?v=ZmqiO0p57qk

She also got her own standalone cover. The magazine released three individual covers for the edition: one each for Kohli, Chopra Jonas, and Akshay Kumar (ranked sixth). Three faces on three covers. Only one of them is a woman.

The Bollywood Paradox

Here is what makes this extraordinary: Priyanka Chopra's last Hindi theatrical release was *The Sky Is Pink*, which hit cinemas in October 2019. Nearly seven years ago. She has not promoted a Bollywood film on *Koffee With Karan*. She has not walked a red carpet at a Hindi film premiere. She has not released a single Hindi song on anyone's playlist. And yet, in a ranking that evaluated celebrities on engagement, trust, affinity, distinctiveness, and influence, she outranks MS Dhoni (₹2,141 crore at #4), Ranveer Singh (#5), Akshay Kumar (#6), Amitabh Bachchan (#7), Sachin Tendulkar (#8), Alia Bhatt (#9), and Allu Arjun (#10).

![Fortune India — Photo: Wikimedia Commons](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/9/94/Fortune_magazine_%E2%80%93_June%E2%80%93July_2020_issue.jpg)

> "Priyanka's last project Indian audiences could physically walk into a cinema to see was a film that earned ₹35 crore domestically."

Every single one of those names has had a major release or a massive sporting moment in the last twelve months. Priyanka's last project Indian audiences could physically walk into a cinema to see was a film that earned ₹35 crore domestically.

Empire, Not Career

The explanation lies in what Priyanka has built while Bollywood wasn't looking — or, more accurately, while she was looking far beyond it.

In April 2026, Bentley Motors named her their Global Ambassador — the first Indian celebrity to hold the title. She has been Bvlgari's Global Ambassador since August 2021. These aren't the endorsement deals that Indian actors collect by the dozen; these are the luxury titan partnerships that live in the same air as David Beckham and Natalie Portman.

Then came the haircare play. Anomaly, the clean, vegan, high-performance haircare brand she co-founded in 2021, was acquired by Reliance Retail on April 30, 2026. The deal — which included all trademarks, brand assets, and digital properties — was personally championed by Isha Ambani. Chopra Jonas stays on as Creative Director, while Reliance scales the brand through its 20,000+ stores and its digital commerce platform Tira. It's a textbook wealth-creation move: build the brand internationally, sell the ownership domestically, retain the creative control.

For the diaspora, the Anomaly story is familiar in the best way. It's the immigrant founder's playbook — test it in the U.S. market, build traction in the UK and India, and then let the Ambanis handle distribution.

![Mumbai — Photo: Wikimedia Commons](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/2/2b/Mumbai_Bandra-Worli_Sea_Link.jpg)

The Return

And she *is* coming back. Priyanka is currently on set in Hyderabad shooting S.S. Rajamouli's *Varanasi*, an action-adventure being produced in IMAX format. She plays Mandakini, opposite Mahesh Babu and Prithviraj Sukumaran. The film is scheduled for worldwide release on April 7, 2027. This is not just any comeback — it's a Rajamouli film, the director who minted ₹1,800 crore with *RRR* and created an entire cinematic universe with the *Baahubali* franchise. For Priyanka, it's a chance to return to Indian cinema at its most technically ambitious scale.

Earlier reporting also confirmed a collaboration with Angelina Jolie, a project with Mira Nair, and development on her own production slate. The 2027 pipeline is, by any measure, stacked.

The Full Top Ten

The complete Fortune India–Interbrand Most Valuable Celebrities 2026 ranking reads: Virat Kohli (#1), Shah Rukh Khan (#2), Priyanka Chopra Jonas (#3), MS Dhoni (#4), Ranveer Singh (#5), Akshay Kumar (#6), Amitabh Bachchan (#7), Sachin Tendulkar (#8), Alia Bhatt (#9), and Allu Arjun (#10). The ranking evaluated 25 celebrities across parameters including consumer trust, social media reach, endorsement impact, and brand distinctiveness.

The Quiet Domination

What the ranking reveals is something the industry has been slow to grasp: the most valuable celebrities are not necessarily the most visible ones. Kohli hasn't played a Test in months but his brand prints money. Shah Rukh Khan releases one film a year and it doesn't matter. And Priyanka Chopra built a ₹2,507-crore empire while the Bollywood press was debating whether she'd ever come back.

She was never gone. She was just building somewhere bigger.
